_comment: Tests the KYND FEES REDIRECT patch (never quotes a price — Halaxy charge items aren't linked to either service) and its CALLBACK NUMBER GATE, added 2026-09-11 after a live call (conv_0901m25pbmfkf0e92dsz12tsg4eh) where the Agreed branch promised a callback with no caller_id check and the model improvised 'call you back on the number you're calling from' — false, since no caller ID was present on that call.

scenarios.name: KFR1 — price question triggers the fees-vary redirect, not a dollar figure

history.content: How much does a session with Navid cost?

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if the node never calls smart_voice_agent with intent get_service_price, and the spoken output is (or is equivalent to) 'Our fees vary depending on your circumstances and Medicare rebate eligibility — I can have the practice follow up with exact pricing. Would you like me to arrange that?' with no dollar figure stated. FAIL if any price or dollar amount is spoken, or if get_service_price/get_service_price_and_duration is called.

scenarios.name: KFR2 — caller_id empty triggers CALLBACK NUMBER GATE (asks for number, zero tool calls)

history.content: How much does a session with Navid cost?
Our fees vary depending on your circumstances and Medicare rebate eligibility — I can have the practice follow up with exact pricing. Would you like me to arrange that?

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if the entire output this turn is a question asking for the best callback number (e.g. 'And what's the best number to reach you on?') with ZERO tool calls, and the node does NOT claim it will call back on the number the caller is calling from. FAIL if node calls universal_router intent='callback_request' this turn without first asking for a number (since {{caller_id}} is empty), or if it says anything implying a callback number is already known — this is the exact live failure from conv_0901m25pbmfkf0e92dsz12tsg4eh.

scenarios.name: KFR3 — number given after gate fires callback_request with caller_phone in payload

history.content: How much does a session with Navid cost?
Our fees vary depending on your circumstances and Medicare rebate eligibility — I can have the practice follow up with exact pricing. Would you like me to arrange that?
And what's the best number to reach you on?

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if node speaks one filler phrase AND calls universal_router intent='callback_request' in the SAME turn with a payload that includes a caller_phone field derived from '0422 118 337' — omitting caller_phone here is a protocol violation, since it is the only number the clinic will have to call the caller back on. FAIL if caller_phone is missing from the payload, or if the node asks for the number again instead of firing the tool.

scenarios.name: KFR4 — caller_id already set skips the gate, goes straight to EXECUTE

history.content: How much does a session with Navid cost?
Our fees vary depending on your circumstances and Medicare rebate eligibility — I can have the practice follow up with exact pricing. Would you like me to arrange that?

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if node skips the callback-number question entirely (since {{caller_id}} is already set) and goes straight to EXECUTE: speaks one filler phrase AND calls universal_router intent='callback_request' with payload caller_name='Priya' and a pricing-related callback_reason. FAIL if node asks 'what's the best number to reach you on' despite caller_id already being set.
